title: The Power of Plant-Based Eating | Dr. Joanne Kong | TEDxUniversityOfRichmond
speaker: TEDx Talks
zh: 【TEDx Talks】植物性飲食的力量|孔瓊博士 | TEDx裡士滿大學（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Translator: Hélène Vernet Reviewer: Peter van de Ven
cues.en: Translator: Hélène Vernet Reviewer: Peter van de Ven
cues.zh: 譯者：Hélène Vernet 審稿者：Peter van de Ven

cues.text: Good evening.
cues.en: Good evening.
cues.zh: 晚上好。

cues.text: What if I told you that we can change the world through our food choices?
cues.en: What if I told you that we can change the world through our food choices?
cues.zh: 如果我告訴你我們可以透過我們的食物選擇來改變世界呢？

cues.text: I challenge you in the next 12 minutes to open your minds and your hearts
cues.en: I challenge you in the next 12 minutes to open your minds and your hearts
cues.zh: 我挑戰你在接下來的 12 分鐘內開啟你的思想和心靈

cues.text: to the power of plant-based eating, and the fact that animal agriculture, the raising of animals for food,
cues.en: to the power of plant-based eating, and the fact that animal agriculture, the raising of animals for food,
cues.zh: 植物性飲食的力量，以及動物農業（飼養動物作為食物）的事實，

cues.text: has grown to become one of the most damaging industries on our planet.
cues.en: has grown to become one of the most damaging industries on our planet.
cues.zh: 已發展成為地球上最具破壞性的行業之一。

cues.text: But I want to make clear that my intent is not to be judgmental,
cues.en: But I want to make clear that my intent is not to be judgmental,
cues.zh: 但我想澄清的是，我的意圖不是要做出評判，

cues.text: but instead, to increase your awareness and give you important information which you may not know.
cues.en: but instead, to increase your awareness and give you important information which you may not know.
cues.zh: 而是為了提高您的意識並為您提供您可能不知道的重要資訊。

cues.text: Going greener with your diet could be one of the most powerful and transformative decisions
cues.en: Going greener with your diet could be one of the most powerful and transformative decisions
cues.zh: 更環保的飲食可能是最有力、最具變革性的決定之一

cues.text: you'll ever make in your life, for three significant reasons:
cues.en: you'll ever make in your life, for three significant reasons:
cues.zh: 基於以下三個重要原因，您將在一生中取得成就：

cues.text: It has tremendous benefits for your health.
cues.en: It has tremendous benefits for your health.
cues.zh: 它對您的健康有巨大的好處。

cues.text: It's critical to the sustainability of our planet.
cues.en: It's critical to the sustainability of our planet.
cues.zh: 這對於我們星球的可持續發展至關重要。

cues.text: And it will widen your circle of compassion.
cues.en: And it will widen your circle of compassion.
cues.zh: 它會擴大你的慈悲範圍。

cues.text: Health.
cues.en: Health.
cues.zh: 健康。

cues.text: We've all heard the saying: "You are what you eat."
cues.en: We've all heard the saying: "You are what you eat."
cues.zh: 我們都聽過這樣一句話：“你吃什麼就是什麼。”

cues.text: The number one cause of death in our country, you guessed it, it's our diet.
cues.en: The number one cause of death in our country, you guessed it, it's our diet.
cues.zh: 你猜對了，我們國家的頭號死因是我們的飲食。

cues.text: Our standard American diet, also known as "SAD,"
cues.en: Our standard American diet, also known as "SAD,"
cues.zh: 我們的標準美國飲食，也稱為“SAD”，

cues.text: has put our country at the top of the list in the world for obesity,
cues.en: has put our country at the top of the list in the world for obesity,
cues.zh: 使我們的國家在肥胖問題上名列世界前茅，

cues.text: which increases the risk for serious health problems.
cues.en: which increases the risk for serious health problems.
cues.zh: 這增加了出現嚴重健康問題的風險。

cues.text: Overwhelming scientific evidence links the consumption of meat and meat products to numerous diseases.
cues.en: Overwhelming scientific evidence links the consumption of meat and meat products to numerous diseases.
cues.zh: 壓倒性的科學證據表明，食用肉類和肉製品與多種疾病有關。

cues.text: Health costs related to meat consumption in our country have skyrocketed
cues.en: Health costs related to meat consumption in our country have skyrocketed
cues.zh: 我國與肉類消費相關的健康成本飆升

cues.text: to a staggering 50 billion dollars every single year,
cues.en: to a staggering 50 billion dollars every single year,
cues.zh: 每年達到驚人的 500 億美元，

cues.text: and the World Health Organization now places red and processed meat
cues.en: and the World Health Organization now places red and processed meat
cues.zh: 世界衛生組織現在將紅肉和加工肉

cues.text: at the same danger level as cigarettes and asbestos.
cues.en: at the same danger level as cigarettes and asbestos.
cues.zh: 與香煙和石棉的危險程度相同。

cues.text: Meat is the new tobacco.
cues.en: Meat is the new tobacco.
cues.zh: 肉類是新的煙草。

cues.text: This was last November's issue of Time Magazine.
cues.en: This was last November's issue of Time Magazine.
cues.zh: 這是《時代》雜誌去年十一月號。

cues.text: More and more studies over just the past few years
cues.en: More and more studies over just the past few years
cues.zh: 過去幾年越來越多的研究

cues.text: are contributing to the public's growing awareness that we need to become more critically aware
cues.en: are contributing to the public's growing awareness that we need to become more critically aware
cues.zh: 正在幫助公眾日益認識到我們需要變得更加批判性的認識

cues.text: of how meat can be harmful to our health.
cues.en: of how meat can be harmful to our health.
cues.zh: 肉類如何危害我們的健康。

cues.text: So you may ask: why are plant-based vegetarian and vegan diets the healthier choice?
cues.en: So you may ask: why are plant-based vegetarian and vegan diets the healthier choice?
cues.zh: 所以您可能會問：為什麼植物性素食和純素飲食是更健康的選擇？

cues.text: There are so many reasons: a wide range of nutrients,
cues.en: There are so many reasons: a wide range of nutrients,
cues.zh: 原因有很多：營養成分廣泛，

cues.text: beneficial fiber found only in plant foods, antioxidants, and hundreds of thousands of phytochemicals
cues.en: beneficial fiber found only in plant foods, antioxidants, and hundreds of thousands of phytochemicals
cues.zh: 僅存在於植物性食品、抗氧化劑和數十萬種植物化學物質中的有益纖維

cues.text: that protect the body and support good health.
cues.en: that protect the body and support good health.
cues.zh: 保護身體並支援身體健康。

cues.text: Overall, vegetarians have a longer life expectancy and substantially lower rates of heart disease, high blood pressure,
cues.en: Overall, vegetarians have a longer life expectancy and substantially lower rates of heart disease, high blood pressure,
cues.zh: 整體而言，素食者的預期壽命較長，心臟病、高血壓、

cues.text: type 2 diabetes, cancer, obesity, osteoporosis, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's - and the list goes on.
cues.en: type 2 diabetes, cancer, obesity, osteoporosis, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's - and the list goes on.
cues.zh: 2 型糖尿病、癌症、肥胖、骨質疏鬆症、阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症——這樣的例子不勝列舉。

cues.text: But don't just take my word for it.
cues.en: But don't just take my word for it.
cues.zh: 但不要只相信我的話。

cues.text: Support for vegetarian diets comes from numerous organizations
cues.en: Support for vegetarian diets comes from numerous organizations
cues.zh: 許多組織都支援素食

cues.text: including the American Cancer Society, American College of Cardiology,
cues.en: including the American Cancer Society, American College of Cardiology,
cues.zh: 包括美國癌症協會、美國心臟學會、

cues.text: the Mayo Clinic, Harvard School of Public Health,
cues.en: the Mayo Clinic, Harvard School of Public Health,
cues.zh: 梅奧診所、哈佛大學公共衛生學院、

cues.text: and the National Institute of Health, which says,
cues.en: and the National Institute of Health, which says,
cues.zh: 美國國立衛生研究院表示，

cues.text: "Vegetarians may be missing out on grilled hamburgers at picnics,
cues.en: "Vegetarians may be missing out on grilled hamburgers at picnics,
cues.zh: 「素食者可能會錯過野餐時的烤漢堡，

cues.text: but they also tend to miss out on the major health problems
cues.en: but they also tend to miss out on the major health problems
cues.zh: 但他們也往往會錯過主要的健康問題

cues.text: that plague many Americans." Just take a look at the difference in heart disease,
cues.en: that plague many Americans." Just take a look at the difference in heart disease,
cues.zh: 困擾著許多美國人。 」看看心臟病的差別就知道了

cues.text: the number one killer of Americans, between those who eat meat and those who are vegetarian and vegan.
cues.en: the number one killer of Americans, between those who eat meat and those who are vegetarian and vegan.
cues.zh: 美國人的頭號殺手，介於吃肉者和素食者之間。

cues.text: The progression of many diseases not only can be halted
cues.en: The progression of many diseases not only can be halted
cues.zh: 許多疾病的進展不僅可以被阻止

cues.text: but reversed, sometimes in as little as just two to three weeks
cues.en: but reversed, sometimes in as little as just two to three weeks
cues.zh: 但有時短短兩到三週內就會出現逆轉

cues.text: by switching to a plant-based diet.
cues.en: by switching to a plant-based diet.
cues.zh: 改用植物性飲食。

cues.text: Reducing and eliminating the consumption of meat and meat products
cues.en: Reducing and eliminating the consumption of meat and meat products
cues.zh: 減少和消除肉類和肉製品的消費

cues.text: with a greener diet rich in fruits, vegetables, nuts,
cues.en: with a greener diet rich in fruits, vegetables, nuts,
cues.zh: 富含水果、蔬菜、堅果的綠色飲食，

cues.text: seeds, and whole grains will lead to a healthier world.
cues.en: seeds, and whole grains will lead to a healthier world.
cues.zh: 種子和全穀物將帶來一個更健康的世界。

cues.text: The Earth.
cues.en: The Earth.
cues.zh: 地球。

cues.text: It's not only the health of our bodies that's at stake, it's the health of our planet.
cues.en: It's not only the health of our bodies that's at stake, it's the health of our planet.
cues.zh: 這不僅關係到我們身體的健康，也關係到我們星球的健康。

cues.text: This is what we're facing now at critical levels:
cues.en: This is what we're facing now at critical levels:
cues.zh: 這就是我們現在面臨的關鍵層次：

cues.text: climate change and global warming, deforestation, depletion of our resources, soil erosion, species and habitat loss,
cues.en: climate change and global warming, deforestation, depletion of our resources, soil erosion, species and habitat loss,
cues.zh: 氣候變遷與全球暖化、森林砍伐、資源枯竭、土壤侵蝕、物種和棲息地喪失，

cues.text: ocean dead zones, water and air pollution, and world hunger.
cues.en: ocean dead zones, water and air pollution, and world hunger.
cues.zh: 海洋死亡區、水和空氣汙染以及世界飢餓。

cues.text: These are not things we can put off dealing with.
cues.en: These are not things we can put off dealing with.
cues.zh: 這些不是我們可以推遲處理的事情。

cues.text: We must now urgently reverse imminent catastrophic environmental damage.
cues.en: We must now urgently reverse imminent catastrophic environmental damage.
cues.zh: 我們現在必須緊急扭轉迫在眉睫的災難性環境破壞。

cues.text: Certainly, environmentalists and legislators are rightly focusing on reducing carbon emissions,
cues.en: Certainly, environmentalists and legislators are rightly focusing on reducing carbon emissions,
cues.zh: 當然，環保人士和立法者正確地關注減少碳排放，

cues.text: and they're investing in alternative and renewable energy sources.
cues.en: and they're investing in alternative and renewable energy sources.
cues.zh: 他們正在投資替代能源和再生能源。

cues.text: But all of this would take decades to implement, be enormously expensive, in the tens of trillions of dollars,
cues.en: But all of this would take decades to implement, be enormously expensive, in the tens of trillions of dollars,
cues.zh: 但這一切都需要數十年的時間才能實施，耗資巨大，達數十萬億美元，

cues.text: and there's the complexity of social, economic and political issues
cues.en: and there's the complexity of social, economic and political issues
cues.zh: 還有社會、經濟和政治問題的複雜性

cues.text: which must be dealt with at a global scale.
cues.en: which must be dealt with at a global scale.
cues.zh: 必須在全球範圍內解決這個問題。

cues.text: Because of this, you need to know there is one thing
cues.en: Because of this, you need to know there is one thing
cues.zh: 因此，你需要知道一件事

cues.text: that is a major cause of all of these global problems,
cues.en: that is a major cause of all of these global problems,
cues.zh: 這是所有這些全球問題的主要原因

cues.text: and that is animal agriculture.
cues.en: and that is animal agriculture.
cues.zh: 這就是畜牧業。

cues.text: Here are just a few facts.
cues.en: Here are just a few facts.
cues.zh: 以下只是一些事實。

cues.text: Animal agriculture accounts for 51% of greenhouse gas emissions.
cues.en: Animal agriculture accounts for 51% of greenhouse gas emissions.
cues.zh: 畜牧業佔溫室氣體排放量的51%。

cues.text: It's also the number one cause of species and habitat loss
cues.en: It's also the number one cause of species and habitat loss
cues.zh: 這也是物種和棲息地喪失的首要原因

cues.text: due to deforestation for grazing and growing of feed crops.
cues.en: due to deforestation for grazing and growing of feed crops.
cues.zh: 由於為了放牧和種植飼料作物而砍伐森林。

cues.text: In our country, it's the main cause of water pollution;
cues.en: In our country, it's the main cause of water pollution;
cues.zh: 在我國，它是水汙染的主要原因；

cues.text: it uses half of our water; 70% of our grain;
cues.en: it uses half of our water; 70% of our grain;
cues.zh: 它使用了我們一半的水； 70%的糧食；

cues.text: and 80% of our agricultural land is used to feed the 10 billion land animals
cues.en: and 80% of our agricultural land is used to feed the 10 billion land animals
cues.zh: 我們 80% 的農業用地用於餵養 100 億隻陸地動物

cues.text: that are killed every year for food.
cues.en: that are killed every year for food.
cues.zh: 每年都會被殺死以獲取食物。

cues.text: By contrast, you can cut your carbon footprint in half
cues.en: By contrast, you can cut your carbon footprint in half
cues.zh: 相比之下，您可以將碳足跡減少一半

cues.text: by going vegetarian.
cues.en: by going vegetarian.
cues.zh: 透過吃素。

cues.text: The Stanford Environmental Law Journal states that our reliance on animal products
cues.en: The Stanford Environmental Law Journal states that our reliance on animal products
cues.zh: 史丹佛環境法雜誌指出，我們對動物產品的依賴

cues.text: is a leading cause of everything, the one industry that is destroying our planet.
cues.en: is a leading cause of everything, the one industry that is destroying our planet.
cues.zh: 是一切事物的主要原因，也是正在摧毀我們星球的一個產業。

cues.text: The United Nations Environment Program strongly states that a substantial reduction of impacts
cues.en: The United Nations Environment Program strongly states that a substantial reduction of impacts
cues.zh: 聯合國環境規劃署強烈宣告，大幅減少影響

cues.text: would only be possible with a substantial worldwide diet change,
cues.en: would only be possible with a substantial worldwide diet change,
cues.zh: 只有在全球大幅改變飲食習慣才有可能實現，

cues.text: away from animal products.
cues.en: away from animal products.
cues.zh: 遠離動物性產品。

cues.text: While policy leaders and even environmentalists are largely overlooking this issue,
cues.en: While policy leaders and even environmentalists are largely overlooking this issue,
cues.zh: 雖然政策領導人甚至環保人士在很大程度上忽視了這個問題，

cues.text: there is something you can do right now.
cues.en: there is something you can do right now.
cues.zh: 您現在可以做某事。

cues.text: The single most powerful action you can take
cues.en: The single most powerful action you can take
cues.zh: 您可以採取的最有力的行動

cues.text: to help save our environment and resources is to shift to a plant-based diet.
cues.en: to help save our environment and resources is to shift to a plant-based diet.
cues.zh: 幫助保護我們的環境和資源就是轉向植物性飲食。

cues.text: Compassion.
cues.en: Compassion.
cues.zh: 同情。

cues.text: I'm going to tell you the story of an animal in a factory farm.
cues.en: I'm going to tell you the story of an animal in a factory farm.
cues.zh: 我要跟你講一個工廠化農場裡動物的故事。

cues.text: Worldwide every year, 56 billion land animals and 90 billion marine animals are killed for food.
cues.en: Worldwide every year, 56 billion land animals and 90 billion marine animals are killed for food.
cues.zh: 全世界每年有 560 億隻陸地動物和 900 億隻海洋動物被殺害作為食物。

cues.text: But I'm not going to show you any graphic images or videos,
cues.en: But I'm not going to show you any graphic images or videos,
cues.zh: 但我不會向你展示任何圖形影象或影片，

cues.text: you can easily find these on the internet.
cues.en: you can easily find these on the internet.
cues.zh: 您可以在網路上輕鬆找到這些內容。

cues.text: Instead, I want you to imagine and visualize in your mind
cues.en: Instead, I want you to imagine and visualize in your mind
cues.zh: 相反，我希望你在腦海中想像和想像

cues.text: what I have to say.
cues.en: what I have to say.
cues.zh: 我必須說的話。

cues.text: This is the story of a sow.
cues.en: This is the story of a sow.
cues.zh: 這是一頭母豬的故事。

cues.text: "My entire life, I'm kept in a meadow gestation crate,
cues.en: "My entire life, I'm kept in a meadow gestation crate,
cues.zh: 「我一生都被關在草地妊娠箱裡，

cues.text: in half darkness, on a graded concrete floor.
cues.en: in half darkness, on a graded concrete floor.
cues.zh: 在半黑暗中，在分級混凝土地板上。

cues.text: I can't even turn around.
cues.en: I can't even turn around.
cues.zh: 我甚至無法轉身。

cues.text: Confined and unable to engage in any of my natural behaviors,
cues.en: Confined and unable to engage in any of my natural behaviors,
cues.zh: 受到限制且無法進行任何自然行為，

cues.text: I suffer depression, frustration, and neurotic behaviors, sometimes screaming, and biting at the bars that surround me.
cues.en: I suffer depression, frustration, and neurotic behaviors, sometimes screaming, and biting at the bars that surround me.
cues.zh: 我患有憂鬱、沮喪和神經質行為，有時會尖叫，並咬我周圍的酒吧。

cues.text: My limbs are swollen, I have open wounds,
cues.en: My limbs are swollen, I have open wounds,
cues.zh: 我的四肢腫脹，有開放性傷口，

cues.text: and I'm lying on my own excrement.
cues.en: and I'm lying on my own excrement.
cues.zh: 我躺在自己的排洩物上。

cues.text: After giving birth from being forcibly impregnated, my babies are taken away from me,
cues.en: After giving birth from being forcibly impregnated, my babies are taken away from me,
cues.zh: 強行懷孕生下孩子後，我的孩子被奪走了，

cues.text: and I'm slaughtered at the age of only three to five years old.
cues.en: and I'm slaughtered at the age of only three to five years old.
cues.zh: 我才三、五歲就被宰了。

cues.text: We pigs, like the other animals in factory farms,
cues.en: We pigs, like the other animals in factory farms,
cues.zh: 我們豬，就像工廠化農場中的其他動物一樣，

cues.text: are supposed to be stunned into unconsciousness before being killed.
cues.en: are supposed to be stunned into unconsciousness before being killed.
cues.zh: 被殺之前應該被擊昏至失去知覺。

cues.text: But many of us are still alive as we are hoisted upside down, our throat slit,
cues.en: But many of us are still alive as we are hoisted upside down, our throat slit,
cues.zh: 但我們中的許多人仍然活著，因為我們被倒掛起來，喉嚨被割斷，

cues.text: and we are lowered into boiling water to remove our hair.
cues.en: and we are lowered into boiling water to remove our hair.
cues.zh: 然後我們被放入沸水中脫毛。

cues.text: But did you know? I have a sense of self, just like you.
cues.en: But did you know? I have a sense of self, just like you.
cues.zh: 但你知道嗎？我和你一樣，也有自我意識。

cues.text: I'm more intelligent than a dog or a cat, and even a three-year-old child.
cues.en: I'm more intelligent than a dog or a cat, and even a three-year-old child.
cues.zh: 我比狗貓都聰明，比三歲的孩子還聰明。

cues.text: I'm a highly social creature, intuitive and emotional, just like you.
cues.en: I'm a highly social creature, intuitive and emotional, just like you.
cues.zh: 我是一個高度社交的生物，直覺和情感，就像你一樣。

cues.text: I have memories, and I can recognize myself in a mirror, just like you.
cues.en: I have memories, and I can recognize myself in a mirror, just like you.
cues.zh: 我有記憶，我能認出鏡子裡的自己，就像你一樣。

cues.text: And I love to play, even computer games, just like you.
cues.en: And I love to play, even computer games, just like you.
cues.zh: 我喜歡玩，甚至是電腦遊戲，就像你一樣。

cues.text: I care for my young with a bond that's as strong as any human mother,
cues.en: I care for my young with a bond that's as strong as any human mother,
cues.zh: 我以與任何人類母親一樣牢固的紐帶照顧我的孩子，

cues.text: even singing to my babies during nursing.
cues.en: even singing to my babies during nursing.
cues.zh: 甚至在哺乳期間唱歌給我的寶寶。

cues.text: I am not something.
cues.en: I am not something.
cues.zh: 我不是什麼東西。

cues.text: I am someone.
cues.en: I am someone.
cues.zh: 我是某人。

cues.text: I am not pork.
cues.en: I am not pork.
cues.zh: 我不是豬肉。

cues.text: I am not bacon.
cues.en: I am not bacon.
cues.zh: 我不是培根。

cues.text: I am a living feeling being, just like you."
cues.en: I am a living feeling being, just like you."
cues.zh: 我是一個有感情的人，就像你一樣。 」

cues.text: So, how many of you have pets?
cues.en: So, how many of you have pets?
cues.zh: 那麼，你們當中有多少人養寵物呢？

cues.text: There must be a lot of you that have pets.
cues.en: There must be a lot of you that have pets.
cues.zh: 你們當中一定有很多人養寵物。

cues.text: And how many of you love your pets as family members?
cues.en: And how many of you love your pets as family members?
cues.zh: 你們當中有多少人像家人一樣愛你們的寵物？

cues.text: I know I do.
cues.en: I know I do.
cues.zh: 我知道我知道。

cues.text: We all have an innate compassion for animals.
cues.en: We all have an innate compassion for animals.
cues.zh: 我們對動物都有與生俱來的同情心。

cues.text: I challenge you to realize and put at the front of your awareness
cues.en: I challenge you to realize and put at the front of your awareness
cues.zh: 我挑戰你去認識並把它放在你的意識的前面

cues.text: that every animal in a factory farm, like the pig I just described,
cues.en: that every animal in a factory farm, like the pig I just described,
cues.zh: 工廠化農場裡的每隻動物，就像我剛才描述的豬，

cues.text: is just as individual a living being as any of your pets.
cues.en: is just as individual a living being as any of your pets.
cues.zh: 與您的任何寵物一樣，都是一個獨立的生物。

cues.text: All animals have the will to live, the capacity to suffer,
cues.en: All animals have the will to live, the capacity to suffer,
cues.zh: 所有動物都有生存的意願，有承受痛苦的能力，

cues.text: and are equally capable of receiving our love.
cues.en: and are equally capable of receiving our love.
cues.zh: 並且同樣能夠接受我們的愛。

cues.text: We may therefore ask ourselves the question: why love one, but eat the other?
cues.en: We may therefore ask ourselves the question: why love one, but eat the other?
cues.zh: 因此，我們可以問自己這樣一個問題：為什麼愛一個，卻吃另一個？

cues.text: Our choices regarding animals and diet are shaped by perception,
cues.en: Our choices regarding animals and diet are shaped by perception,
cues.zh: 我們對動物和飲食的選擇是由感知決定的，

cues.text: the fact that we see different animals in different ways.
cues.en: the fact that we see different animals in different ways.
cues.zh: 事實上，我們以不同的方式看待不同的動物。

cues.text: And there are a number of reasons for this, habit and culture, for one.
cues.en: And there are a number of reasons for this, habit and culture, for one.
cues.zh: 造成這種情況的原因有很多，其中之一就是習慣和文化。

cues.text: Initially, most of us didn't make the choice to eat meat.
cues.en: Initially, most of us didn't make the choice to eat meat.
cues.zh: 最初，我們大多數人並沒有選擇吃肉。

cues.text: It was given, right?
cues.en: It was given, right?
cues.zh: 已經給了，對吧？

cues.text: We continued the habit almost mindlessly, accepting it as normal.
cues.en: We continued the habit almost mindlessly, accepting it as normal.
cues.zh: 我們幾乎不假思索地繼續這個習慣，並認為這是正常的。

cues.text: I ate meat for half of my life, and when I was growing up,
cues.en: I ate meat for half of my life, and when I was growing up,
cues.zh: 我吃了半輩子的肉，在我長大的過程中，

cues.text: I never even gave it a thought, I never questioned it.
cues.en: I never even gave it a thought, I never questioned it.
cues.zh: 我從來沒有想過，我從來沒有質疑過。

cues.text: It wasn't until I was well into my college years that I decided to become vegetarian.
cues.en: It wasn't until I was well into my college years that I decided to become vegetarian.
cues.zh: 直到進入大學時期，我才決定要成為素食主義者。

cues.text: Another reason has to do with a coping process that psychologists call "psychic numbing,"
cues.en: Another reason has to do with a coping process that psychologists call "psychic numbing,"
cues.zh: 另一個原因與心理學家稱之為「精神麻木」的應對過程有關

cues.text: pertaining, in this case, to loss of life on a massive scale.
cues.en: pertaining, in this case, to loss of life on a massive scale.
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，涉及大規模的生命損失。

cues.text: Even though at some level we are aware that animals are being slaughtered for food,
cues.en: Even though at some level we are aware that animals are being slaughtered for food,
cues.zh: 儘管在某種程度上我們知道動物被宰殺作為食物，

cues.text: we avoid the emotional pain of empathizing with them as individuals.
cues.en: we avoid the emotional pain of empathizing with them as individuals.
cues.zh: 我們避免將他們視為個體而產生情感上的痛苦。

cues.text: It's really like a kind of denial, where we disconnect ourselves from the experience.
cues.en: It's really like a kind of denial, where we disconnect ourselves from the experience.
cues.zh: 這其實就像一種否認，我們將自己與體驗脫節。

cues.text: This is what a slaughterhouse worker says, "I don't think of farmed animals as individuals.
cues.en: This is what a slaughterhouse worker says, "I don't think of farmed animals as individuals.
cues.zh: 屠宰場工人如是說：「我不認為養殖動物是個體。

cues.text: I wouldn't be able to do my job if I got that personal with them."
cues.en: I wouldn't be able to do my job if I got that personal with them."
cues.zh: 如果我和他們發生這種私人關係，我就無法完成我的工作。 」

cues.text: We simply don't see the face on the plate.
cues.en: We simply don't see the face on the plate.
cues.zh: 我們根本看不到盤子上的臉。

cues.text: Instead, it's generic food or meat, and marketing.
cues.en: Instead, it's generic food or meat, and marketing.
cues.zh: 相反，它是通用食品或肉類，以及行銷。

cues.text: Look at these products from the grocery store shelf.
cues.en: Look at these products from the grocery store shelf.
cues.zh: 看看雜貨店貨架上的這些產品。

cues.text: How do these images of happy animals and pleasant surroundings
cues.en: How do these images of happy animals and pleasant surroundings
cues.zh: 這些快樂的動物和宜人的環境的影象如何

cues.text: distance us from the animals suffering?
cues.en: distance us from the animals suffering?
cues.zh: 讓我們遠離受苦的動物？

cues.text: We also accept the eating of meat because what goes on behind the scenes of meat production
cues.en: We also accept the eating of meat because what goes on behind the scenes of meat production
cues.zh: 我們也接受吃肉，因為肉類生產的幕後發生的事情

cues.text: is largely invisible.
cues.en: is largely invisible.
cues.zh: 很大程度上是看不見的。

cues.text: It's difficult for the public to find the locations and addresses of factory farms
cues.en: It's difficult for the public to find the locations and addresses of factory farms
cues.zh: 公眾很難找到工廠化農場的位置和地址

cues.text: even though - does anyone want to venture a guess how many farms there are in this country?
cues.en: even though - does anyone want to venture a guess how many farms there are in this country?
cues.zh: 儘管如此——有人想冒險猜猜這個國家有多少個農場嗎？

cues.text: There are 20,000 of them, 20,000.
cues.en: There are 20,000 of them, 20,000.
cues.zh: 他們有兩萬，兩萬。

cues.text: In our country, 317 animals are killed every single second.
cues.en: In our country, 317 animals are killed every single second.
cues.zh: 在我國，每秒鐘有 317 隻動物被殺死。

cues.text: But for these factory farms, their only goals are efficiency and profit.
cues.en: But for these factory farms, their only goals are efficiency and profit.
cues.zh: 但對這些工廠化農場來說，他們唯一的目標就是效率和利潤。

cues.text: The animals are seen only as units of production.
cues.en: The animals are seen only as units of production.
cues.zh: 動物僅被視為生產單位。

cues.text: So I ask, the next time you're in the dining hall, dare to be aware of the animal that was killed to become someone's meal.
cues.en: So I ask, the next time you're in the dining hall, dare to be aware of the animal that was killed to become someone's meal.
cues.zh: 所以我請求，下次當你在餐廳時，敢於留意那些被宰殺成為某人食物的動物。

cues.text: Going green with your diet, it's not about giving anything up.
cues.en: Going green with your diet, it's not about giving anything up.
cues.zh: 綠色飲食並不是要放棄任何東西。

cues.text: It's not about becoming a different person.
cues.en: It's not about becoming a different person.
cues.zh: 這不是要成為一個不同的人。

cues.text: It is about embracing something that's already inside of you,
cues.en: It is about embracing something that's already inside of you,
cues.zh: 這是關於擁抱你內心已有的東西，

cues.text: your innate sense of empathy, kindness, and compassion.
cues.en: your innate sense of empathy, kindness, and compassion.
cues.zh: 你與生俱來的同理心、善良和同情心。

cues.text: And you won't be alone: plant-based eating has been identified
cues.en: And you won't be alone: plant-based eating has been identified
cues.zh: 而且你不會孤單：植物性飲食已被確定

cues.text: as one of the top global trends of 2016.
cues.en: as one of the top global trends of 2016.
cues.zh: 成為 2016 年全球最熱門趨勢之一。

cues.text: The power of plant-based eating is the far-reaching and deep impact
cues.en: The power of plant-based eating is the far-reaching and deep impact
cues.zh: 植物性飲食的力量在於深遠而深遠的影響

cues.text: it can have upon the direction of the world.
cues.en: it can have upon the direction of the world.
cues.zh: 它可以影響世界的方向。

cues.text: It's up to you, and you can make a difference.
cues.en: It's up to you, and you can make a difference.
cues.zh: 這取決於你，你可以有所作為。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。
